items.headline: Bryce Underwood makes most of second chance, sparks Michigan's upset of UCLA
items.description: Reinserted as Michigan's starting quarterback earlier this week, Bryce Underwood threw a 3-yard 2-point conversion pass Jalen Hoffman, lifting the Wolverines to an 18-16 triple-overtime win over previously unbeaten No. 4 UCLA on Saturday night.
